title: Definition of Public Authority
text: Public authority means any authority or body or institution of self-government established or constituted by or under the Constitution, by any other law made by Parliament or State Legislature, or by notification issued by the appropriate Government.

title: Request for Obtaining Information
text: A person, who desires to obtain any information under this Act, shall make a request in writing or through electronic means in English or Hindi or in the official language of the area in which the application is being made, accompanying such fee as may be prescribed, to the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer.

title: Transfer of Application to Other Public Authority
text: Where an application is made to a public authority requesting for information which is held by another public authority, the public authority shall transfer the application within five days from the date of receipt and immediately inform the applicant.

title: Disposal of Request & 30-Day Mandatory Response
text: The Public Information Officer on receipt of a request under section 6 shall, as expeditiously as possible, and in any case within thirty days of the receipt of the request, either provide the information on payment of such fee as may be prescribed or reject the request for reasons specified in sections 8 and 9. Provided that where the information sought concerns the life or liberty of a person, the same shall be provided within forty-eight hours of receipt.

title: Deemed Refusal
text: If the Public Information Officer fails to give decision on the request for information within the period specified under sub-section (1), the Public Information Officer shall be deemed to have refused the request.

title: First Appeal to Senior Officer
text: Any person who does not receive a decision within thirty days from the Public Information Officer, or is aggrieved by a decision, may within thirty days prefer a first appeal to such officer who is senior in rank to the Public Information Officer in each public authority.
